output.objection: You have the consent checks running manually, which leaves our loyalty basket data exposed at the ingestion boundary. I need that validation fully automated and governed before we sign off on this pipeline.
output.correction: I was not talking about the model training step, I was talking about the data contract hand over. The personal data must be validated at the source, not after it has already entered the system.
